pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

3. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

4. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. blue

6. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

7. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language School.

8. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.

9. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

10. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

11. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

2. A — One main idea with supporting sentences

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

5. C — run

6. C — went

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

9. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

10. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

11. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

12. D — Where is the library?

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Handwriting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Punctuation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
